rows.name: ResearchCommons.Claims.NANUQ.actual_source_cycle_circle
rows.type:
@Claims.NANUQ.actual_source_cycle_circle : ∀ {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {G : Nanuq.Source.EdgeGraph V E}
  (D : G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.PlanarCurves G) {a b : V} (w z : G.OccurrenceWalk a b),
  w.Simple →
    z.Simple →
      w.Nonempty →
        z.Nonempty →
          Disjoint w.edges z.edges →
            (∀ v ∈ w.vertices, v ∈ z.vertices → v = a ∨ v = b) →
              ∃ r,
                Continuous r ∧
                  Function.Injective r ∧
                    Set.range r =
                      Set.range ⇑(Nanuq.Source.EdgeGraph.OccurrenceWalk.curve D.toCurveDrawing w) ∪
                        Set.range ⇑(Nanuq.Source.EdgeGraph.OccurrenceWalk.curve D.toCurveDrawing z)

rows.name: Nanuq.Canonical.theta_source
rows.type:
Nanuq.Canonical.theta_source : ∀ (t : Nanuq.Theta.Counts),
  1 ≤ t.total →
    Nanuq.Reconstruction.CircularDecomposable (Nanuq.Weighted.sourceNanuq (Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t)) ∧
      Nanuq.Reconstruction.PseudometricLaws (Nanuq.Weighted.sourceNanuq (Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t)) ∧
        (∀ (x y : Fin (Nanuq.Theta.circular t).length),
            x ≠ y → 0 < Nanuq.Weighted.sourceNanuq (Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t) x y) ∧
          ∀ (i j : Fin (Nanuq.Theta.circular t).length),
            i < j →
              (0 < Nanuq.Weighted.circularAlpha (Nanuq.Weighted.sourceNanuq (Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t)) i j ↔
                Nanuq.Theta.displayedSplit t ↑i ↑j = true)

rows.name: Nanuq.Canonical.theta_weighted
rows.type:
Nanuq.Canonical.theta_weighted : ∀ (t : Nanuq.Theta.Counts),
  1 ≤ t.total →
    ∀ (mass : Fin (Nanuq.Theta.circular t).length → ℚ),
      (∀ (x : Fin (Nanuq.Theta.circular t).length), 0 < mass x) →
        Nanuq.Reconstruction.CircularDecomposable (Nanuq.Weighted.weightedNanuq (Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t) mass) ∧
          Nanuq.Reconstruction.PseudometricLaws (Nanuq.Weighted.weightedNanuq (Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t) mass) ∧
            ∀ (i j : Fin (Nanuq.Theta.circular t).length),
              i < j →
                (0 < Nanuq.Weighted.circularAlpha (Nanuq.Weighted.weightedNanuq (Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t) mass) i j ↔
                  Nanuq.Theta.displayedSplit t ↑i ↑j = true)

rows.name: Nanuq.Canonical.theta_exact_quartet_mean
rows.type:
Nanuq.Canonical.theta_exact_quartet_mean : ∀ (t : Nanuq.Theta.Counts) (a b c d : Fin (Nanuq.Theta.circular t).length),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      a ≠ d →
        b ≠ c →
          b ≠ d →
            c ≠ d →
              Nanuq.Theta.rhoFin t a b c d =
                Nanuq.Quartet.sourceMean
                  (Nanuq.Theta.sourceResolution t (Nanuq.Theta.leafIndex t a) (Nanuq.Theta.leafIndex t b)
                    (Nanuq.Theta.leafIndex t c) (Nanuq.Theta.leafIndex t d))
